text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tunisian football team qualified for the World Cup tournament in France next year after a draw with Egypt in a match played on Sunday in Cairo.
- President Ben Ali and his wife Leila visited on Saturday the new park "Ennahli" in Ariana district near Tunis.
- An International meeting on foreign financing of the 9th development plan 1997-2001 is to be held this week in Tunis.
- President Ben Ali congratulates the Tunisian football team for his qualification for the World Cup 1998 in France.
- Tunisia and Mauritania to boost cooperation on pharmaceutical industry and medicine exchanges.
